scope: Boolean rational finite current incumbent-sublevel upper-bound delivery, nonempty with a separately checked supplied incumbent
legacy_tree_export: separate receiver-format diagnostic; not a restricted ordinary benchmark substitute
tariff: observed worker Python opcode events, bounded native C-call events, each explicitly priced at one; input/output/source and serialized-state byte-periods each priced at one; declared delivery/eviction events each priced at one
threshold_interpretation: Prospective affordability thresholds on the observed complete consumer bill; low-budget interruption probes are separately labelled executions.
common_source_enrollment: The selected complete worker-source closure is byte-enrolled once per stream; source hashing/checking performed by worker is charged. The fixed CPython and standard-library installation and measurement apparatus are outside that program-byte tariff. Fresh recipient means empty verified facts, not reinstallation of the interpreter.
state_tariff: Serialize every retained producer and recipient scientific state after each admitted request, charge serialization and its byte-period, report bytes separately from the declared scalar tariff. Include unique tables, Apply and expression caches, proof logs, admitted domains and current receipts.
failure_policy: A denied or malformed attempt returns a reserved constant failure response and no current certificate. Publish only a fully paid candidate receiver. Evict warm mutable producer state on failure; stale prior current receipts cannot satisfy the new request ID. Paid work remains in the bill.
break_even: Exact observed cumulative costs through prefixes 1..6, including setup; first crossing and sustained crossing only within that finite horizon. No infinite-horizon extrapolation.
ordinary_controls: Shared portfolio kernels, independently checked ADD bootstrap and direct finite receiver recomputation are admissible. Witness acquisition is a common supplied input, excluded for all arms.
adversarial_scope: stale prefix, source, epoch, order or request ID
resource denial and atomic recipient publication
fresh recipient must replay full evidence
publication_rule: Preserve every executed source revision and failure; amendments must precede their affected runs, state why they changed, and retain the initial contract. No final challenge is frozen or exposed.
